description: Shelters, food, housing, healthcare, support services and showers in one state, filtered by county, category or words in the name, and sorted by distance when a latitude and longitude are given.

lat.description: Latitude to sort by distance (needs lng).

lng.description: Longitude to sort by distance (needs lat).

query.description: Words to match in the provider name, services or address.

radiusMiles.description: Only providers within this distance of lat/lng (default 25).

state.description: Two-letter state code, for example CO.

name: homeless_providers_search
title: Find shelters and services
